herne bay.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Kent
s1loc: Herne Bay is deep into the full-fibre rollout, with Openreach pushing fibre to the premises out through the town and surrounding districts while the alternative networks build alongside. Virgin Media keeps upgrading its cable network, the wider East Kent build pulls in alt-net activity from the likes of Netomnia and its YouFibre brand and Hyperoptic on newer developments, and the Project Gigabit work carries gigabit coverage into the harder-to-reach edges around the CT6 postcodes. These estates, plus schools, the seafront hotels and a spread of multi-site employers across the district, all need structured cabling in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre, plus CCTV and access control.
